title: [Test] Improve test reuse in test_torch.py for out-of-tree backends [1/N]
body:
## Summary

This PR is part of a series of PRs that incrementally refactor `test_torch.py` to improve test reuse for out-of-tree backends.

It moves generic device-aware tests from `TestTorch` to `TestTorchDeviceType`, replacing manual device iteration with the injected `device` parameter.

## Changes

- Move the following tests from `TestTorch` to `TestTorchDeviceType` and replace manual device iteration (`for device in get_all_device_types()`) with the injected `device` parameter:
  - `test_index_add`
  - `test_index_add_all_dtypes`
  - `test_index_add_cornercase`
  - `test_normal_shape`
